facts.text: Kujo Presentations 0.3.0 is live in the Kujolang.ai Showcase with a dedicated guide on Kujo Docs and live examples at presentations.kujolang.ai.
facts.source: kujolang.ai main commit 5d2db4e, content/ecosystem/58-presentations.md; docs.kujolang.ai main commit d0c1d0c, content/showcases/presentations.md; production HTTP verification on 2026-10-03

facts.text: Presentations turns structured deck source into browser-native static sites with numbered slide URLs, an overview, a reading edition, print and PDF output, and optional presenter tools.
facts.source: presentations README.md at commit 5199bc3 and Kujolang.ai Presentations showcase at commit 5d2db4e

facts.text: Authors can start from investor, live-talk, or sales starters and edit deck.json, BRIEF.md, local assets, and theme CSS.
facts.source: presentations README.md at commit 5199bc3; docs.kujolang.ai content/showcases/presentations.md at commit d0c1d0c

facts.text: Generated decks support direct static routes, keyboard and touch navigation, slide-only fullscreen, reduced-motion behavior, optional local Motion bundles, and a reflowing reading edition.
facts.source: presentations README.md and CHANGELOG.md at commit 5199bc3

facts.text: Private speaker notes load from a local JSON file into the presenter tab and are not emitted into generated audience HTML, URLs, or browser storage.
facts.source: kujolang.ai content/ecosystem/58-presentations.md at commit 5d2db4e; presentations docs/presentation-features.md at commit 5199bc3
